description: DEALS (seller): deliver the NEXT step after it was paid (1 confirmation). Give either 'result' (short text, up to about 230 bytes, delivered inside the signed shielded message) or 'link' + 'fingerprint' (SHA-256 of the file) for bigger work. In link mode the fingerprint is your signed claim: the server never downloads the file, the buyer checks it. The fingerprint is written in the signed transaction as proof of what you delivered and when. Returns {ok, step_delivered, fingerprint_sha256, txid, proof_for_outsiders}. Shielded on the blockchain. Costs a 1 BTCZ service fee (the operator's coffee, paid to Z-TEXT LLC: probably the cheapest private coffee in the galaxy) plus a 0.0001 BTCZ network fee. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet).

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 (64 hex) of the file behind the link

link.description: Link to a bigger result (stored outside the blockchain)

result.description: Short result delivered inside the message

name: deal_deliver
